stories.summary: The Ukrainian president says wartime elections, as called for by the ex-defense minister, could "split Ukraine." He also said Russia was planning to mobilize hundreds of thousands of troops after September polls there.

How full are Germany's gas storage levels right now? Germany's more than 40 gas storage facilities are barely over half full, mainly due to the ongoing closure of the Strait of Hormuz — currently the world's most critical energy chokepoint — because of the Iran war .
